name: Lord Windgrace
description: A panther warrior planeswalker and one of Urza's Nine Titans who despises the destructive power of artifice and bound his soul to Urborg.

description_citations.text: "Windgrace". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Windgrace sacrifices his life to protect Urborg, first binding his soul to the land and vowing to watch over it.
timeline.quote: He sacrificed his life to protect his home of Urborg, but not before binding his soul to the land and vowing to always watch over it.
